findings.explanation: Lean returns the same `ARB` pair for every non-variable term. Consequently, `dest_var (Const x ty) = dest_var (Comb s t)` holds by reflexivity for all inputs. HOL4 specifies only `dest_var (Var x ty) = (x,ty)`, which permits different results on `Const` and `Comb`.
findings.repair:
private opaque dest_var_other : term → mlstring × type

noncomputable def dest_var : term → mlstring × type
  | Var x ty => (x, ty)
  | t => dest_var_other t
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSyntax

example (x : mlstring) (ty : type) (s t : term) :
    dest_var (Const x ty) = dest_var (Comb s t) := rfl
findings.hol4_check: ∀x ty s t. ∃f. (∀y u. f (Var y u) = (y,u)) ∧ f (Const x ty) ≠ f (Comb s t)
